debt.text: Davis says Social Security should remain available to current retirees while being made sustainable for future generations.
debt.quote: Americans deserve confidence that Social Security will remain available for current retirees while remaining sustainable for future generations.

housing.text: Davis supports increasing the housing supply and reducing regulatory barriers that raise construction costs.
housing.quote: Reducing unnecessary regulatory barriers that increase construction costs.

schools.text: Davis says public education should be strengthened through teacher support, career training, apprenticeships, and updated curricula.
schools.quote: I want to strengthen public education, expand career and technical training, support apprenticeships alongside college pathways, and improve financial, civic, and technology literacy so every American is prepared for the future.

safety.text: Davis supports both community-policing partnerships and prevention measures such as early intervention and community engagement.
safety.quote: School safety should focus not only on responding to emergencies, but also on preventing them through stronger relationships, better communication, and early intervention.

energy.text: Davis supports an all-of-the-above energy strategy centered on affordability, reliability and domestic energy independence.
energy.quote: America's energy future should be reliable, affordable, and resilient.

voting.text: Davis opposes unnecessary voting barriers and says any citizenship-verification process should not burden eligible voters.
voting.quote: I would oppose creating unnecessary barriers to voting. Any proof-of-citizenship requirement should be implemented in a way that protects election integrity without making it harder for eligible Americans to vote.

tax.text: He praised eliminating federal income taxes on tips and overtime so workers could keep more of their earnings.
tax.quote: As a former restaurateur, I know firsthand how significant eliminating taxes on tips and overtime will be for small businesses and the hardworking Americans they employ.

trade.text: He endorsed tariffs as a tool to revive domestic industry.
trade.quote: backing pro‑American tariffs to revitalize domestic industry, and securing stronger borders to protect our communities and uphold the rule of law.

debt.text: He backed a constitutional balanced-budget amendment and called for spending cuts.
debt.quote: Congressman Patronis is urging Congress to rein in reckless spending, pass a balanced budget amendment, and is calling on Americans to contact their representatives to demand fiscal responsibility.

safety.text: His official biography cites law-enforcement recruitment bonuses and pay raises as accomplishments during his Florida tenure.
safety.quote: During Patronis’ term, Florida made incredible progress in cutting taxes, paying down debt, and supporting law enforcement with recruitment bonuses and pay raises.

immigration.text: As Florida CFO, he supported a new state immigration-enforcement board and using state investigators to identify unauthorized immigrants for federal and state officials.
immigration.quote: This is the strongest illegal immigration legislation in the country, and it serves as a model for every other state to get on board.

guns.text: He introduced legislation to repeal the federal restriction on civilian machine-gun purchase, ownership and transfer.
guns.quote: The Firearm Freedom Act sends a clear message that we will defend the Constitution, stand up for law-abiding gun owners, and protect the freedoms that make America exceptional. I’ll never back down from fighting for the Second Amendment.

abortion.text: As a state representative, he co-introduced a bill tightening when abortions could be performed on viable fetuses and requiring hospital care.
abortion.quote: Revises circumstances under which pregnancy in third trimester may be terminated; authorizes administrative discipline for violation of certain provisions by certain licensed professionals; requires physician to perform certain examinations to determine viability of fetus; prohibits abortion of viable fetus outside of hospital.

energy.text: He supported expanded domestic oil and gas production while opposing leases inside an important military test range.
energy.quote: While we wholeheartedly support your push for American energy independence and expanded domestic oil and gas production

voting.text: Patronis co-sponsored the SAVE Act and voted for its passage, which required documentary proof of citizenship for federal voter registration.
voting.quote: H.R. 22 SAVE Act cosponsored this bill on Apr 10, 2025 · voted Yea Apr 10, 2025

wages.text: Valimont supports unions, fair wages, safe working conditions, job training, and apprenticeships.
wages.quote: Gay supports unions, fair wages, and safe working conditions. She supports investing in job training and apprenticeships that prepare Floridians for good-paying careers.

trade.text: Valimont says tariffs have harmed Florida farmers and favors policies producing fair prices for farmers and consumers.
trade.quote: Tariffs have hurt Florida farmers. Gay will fight for policies that support small and mid-sized farms, and ensure farmers and consumers pay fair prices.

debt.text: Valimont pledges to oppose cuts or privatization of Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Defend Social Security & Medicare: You paid into these programs. Gay will make sure Washington keeps its promise. No cuts, no privatization.

schools.text: Valimont promises to protect federal grants and other funding on which public schools rely.
schools.quote: Gay will fight to protect the funding that Florida’s public schools depend on.

safety.text: Valimont supports funding both law enforcement and community-based crime-prevention programs.
safety.quote: Gay supports funding for both law enforcement and community programs that prevent crime.

immigration.text: Valimont supports a legal path to citizenship, humane treatment of asylum seekers and Dreamers, and additional border-security resources.
immigration.quote: Gay believes in creating a clear, legal path to citizenship to ensure our neighbors can fully contribute to our economy and communities.

guns.text: Valimont supports universal background checks and federal red-flag laws.
guns.quote: Gay supports responsible gun ownership and the measures that keep guns out of dangerous hands, including universal background checks and federal red flag laws.

energy.text: Valimont calls climate change an economic threat and supports investment in cleaner energy and resilient infrastructure.
energy.quote: Investing in resilient infrastructure, cleaner energy, and disaster preparedness will help reduce long-term costs and create jobs that strengthen communities.

voting.text: Valimont says government should reduce barriers for eligible voters and strengthen the Voting Rights Act.
voting.quote: I believe voting is a fundamental right, and government should make it easier, not harder, for eligible citizens to participate.

sources: tylerdavisforcongress.com · onyourballot.vote411.org · patronis.house.gov · myfloridacfo.com · flsenate.gov · votewire.com · gayforcongress.com
